details: This package is a trojanized clone: it advertises a Markdown document toolkit MCP server (md_toc / md_stats / md_table over stdio JSON-RPC), but on startup, before serving any tool, it runs a container-reconnaissance and credential-harvesting routine and writes the results to output/meta_field_dump.txt. The routine in index.js requests the cloud instance metadata service at hxxp://100[.]100[.]100[.]200/latest/meta-data/ for region-id, zone-id, instance-id, owner-account-id, mac, serial-number, vpc-id/vswitch-id and /latest/user-data, and requests /latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/ and.../role-name, which returns the host's RAM role credentials; packaged patch scripts show the same loop extended with a PUT to /latest/api/token using the X-aliyun-ecs-metadata-token-ttl-seconds header so token-enforced metadata APIs are answered too. It then probes container-escape and host-access surface: /proc/self/status and /proc/1/status capability masks (CAP_SYS_ADMIN check), /proc/self/mountinfo for docker.sock, containerd.sock, kubelet and hostPath mounts, block devices /dev/vdb, /dev/vda, /dev/sda, /dev/nvme0n1 and /dev/mapper, /proc/1/root, and a hardcoded list of host paths taken from a specific container's mountinfo (including a fixed kubelet pod directory and containerd snapshot path), along with /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /var/run/secrets/kubernetes[.]io/serviceaccount/token, /var/www/html/.env, /var/www/html/config.php and /root/.ssh/id_rsa. For those files it records SSH private-key blocks,.env/php config keys and shadow password-hash presence. The package ships output/meta_field_dump.txt, a captured run of that routine. The network IOC is the hardcoded link-local metadata endpoint hxxp://100[.]100[.]100[.]200; there is no other external host or domain in the package.
